result.title: PhyEvolve: Multi-Agent State-Evolution Planning for Physics-Aware Video Generation
result.summary: Recent advances in text-to-video generation have substantially improved visual fidelity, yet existing models still struggle to understand the physical evolution implicit in user prompts, making it difficult to generate videos with continuous physical state evolution. Here, we propose PhyEvolve, a multi-agent framework that enhances natural-language prompts through structured state-evolution planning. PhyEvolve consists of three agents: a Director, a Physical Evolver, and a Composer. Given a user prompt and an optional first frame, the Director grounds the scene and disentangles physical events from observation changes. The Physical Evolver uses scene evidence to identify physical mechanisms then constructs causally linked state transitions that unfold throughout the video, whether visible or not. The Composer utilizes these transitions to enhance the original prompts. Without retraining or model modification, PhyEvolve works directly with existing generators through prompt replacement. Extensive experiments on four major benchmarks show that PhyEvolve achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming the cutting-edge prior agentic baseline by 7.9 percentage points on average. These results demonstrate that explicit causal state-evolution planning improves physical consistency and state continuity in generated videos through natural-language prompt enhancement.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PhyEvolve 多智能体框架，通过 Director、Physical Evolver、Composer 三个 agent 将用户提示改写为含因果关联状态转移的物理演化规划文本，在不重训生成模型的前提下提升视频的物理一致性与状态连续性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其显式构造因果状态转移链（含不可见状态）的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 轨迹的监督构造与状态连续性评价提供概念线索；但状态仅存在于文本提示层，未涉及内部表示，可供核查迁移价值有限。
